summary.name: qView
summary.one_liner: qView is a lightweight, minimalist image viewer for Windows, macOS, and Linux, built on Qt5 and released as free, open-source software under GPLv3.
use_cases: lightweight replacement for heavier image viewers
summary.what_it_does: qView is a desktop image viewer designed to be visually minimal, showing just the image and a titlebar with no cluttered interface. It aims to open images almost instantly and switch between them quickly, with low memory and CPU use. Features include animated GIF controls, file history, rotation and mirroring, and multithreaded preloading. It supports common formats including bmp, gif, jpg, png, tiff, and webp, and offers many configurable preferences.
notable: Minimal interface showing only the image and a titlebar
Animated GIF controls, file history, rotation and mirroring
Multithreaded preloading for fast image switching
Built on Qt5 and open source under GPLv3
caveats: Page does not state a platform version minimum or specific supported Linux distributions
Qt5 base may differ from newer Qt releases
